trigger: A complete return-blind, one-request-per-selected-story retrieval pass found that LSEG returns archival boilerplate, too-short content, or story-not-found for some frozen sample events.
amended_primary_measurement_population: Score all and only the 1,445 events with a deterministic cleaned body of at least 100 characters. Keep the parent sample and every availability result for attrition reporting.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not treat a headline-only row as equivalent full-text evidence.
Do not replace an unavailable selected event after observing model annotations or returns.
Do not weaken the Reuters, first-release, explicit-target, single-company, or nontechnical filters.
audit: The 200-event human audit and 60-event second-code subset are sampled only after scoring from the 1,445 body-available events. The audit key records design weights; the dissertation must also report body availability by company, source block, date, and frozen FinBERT stratum.
scientific_interpretation: The estimand becomes economic-materiality measurement among selected Reuters events with LSEG-retrievable substantive full text. Generalisation to all headlines is not assumed.
unchanged: Model route, prompt, label schema, human reliability thresholds, return seal, and downstream stop rules remain unchanged.
